newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Country Heights unit in land sale.
newsitem.headline: Country Heights unit in land sale.

text.p: Country Heights Holdings Bhd's wholly-owned subsidiary, Magnitude Knight Sdn Bhd, has sold an 18.28-acre plot in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, for 16.8 million ringgit ($6.72 million).
Petaling Jaya is a large commercial and residential town on the outskirts of Kuala Lumpur.
The sale of the hotel land to Beyond Gateway Sdn Bhd would result in a net a profit of 4.1 million ringgit at the group level, Country Heights said in a statement.
It added that the disposal would increase group gross earnings per share and net tangible assets per share by 2.7 cents and 1.9 cents repectively for the year ending February 28, 1997.
